name: Torch bracket
description: Day and night (plan g-noc-grafika): a burning torch in an iron bracket on the town wall and on a tower. Light type torch; the flame and glow are added at runtime like the torch post. Shown on a piece of wall / tower so it reads in the Studio; preview it at dusk and night in Scene & lighting.

variants.name: Wall bracket, plain arm
variants.notes: Iron plate, arm and strut, cup with a pitch torch; soot stain above.

variants.name: Wall bracket, forged scroll
variants.notes: Decorative scroll and a drip tray: for the gate and the castle.

variants.name: Tower bracket, iron cage
variants.notes: High on the tower, the torch in a wind cage.

variants.name: Tower bracket by the door
variants.notes: Low plain arm beside the tower door.
